title: November 23 update
summary: A DMZ weapon pass cuts damage on most ARs, SMGs and LMGs to slow close-range time to kill, the Signal 50 gets stronger in DMZ, and the Thanksgiving Duty Roster event starts.

changes.text: DMZ only: damage down about 7-14% for the Axion, Cronen Osprey, Han 86, Hyeon Burst, Kastov 762, M4, Cronen Squall, Oden and Patriot XMR. The Oden keeps 60 max damage. Ranges are unchanged.
DMZ only: damage down about 4-14% for the CSG-35, ISO Nightshade, PPSh-41, VEL 46, Wz.55 Striga and X-58 Nyx. Ranges are unchanged.
DMZ only: damage down about 10-15% for the APOC-338, FiNN LMG and Type 73. Ranges are unchanged.
DMZ only: mid damage up from 145 to 180, min damage up from 140 to 168, head multiplier up from 1.3 to 1.6. Max damage stays 235.

modes: New Thanksgiving Duty Roster event: earn points for kills (10 per Multiplayer kill, 20 per Warzone kill, 2 per DMZ kill) and climb a leaderboard for rewards like the Bird Call Astaroth .57 Blueprint.
Ground War: Combat Outpost is now 24v24.
Wager Match: Gauntlet 1v1 rewards are doubled, and each win in a row adds 10 trophies to the next wager.
DMZ: closed several exploits and fixed Iron Citadel keycard, Weapon Insurance and Fallen Ember Boathouse Key issues.
DMZ: Possum and Possum Pro Traits no longer stack.
other: Fixed several stability issues.
Event leaderboard profiles no longer show incomplete player data.
The Diresteel Ultra bundle was wrongly labeled a Tracer Pack. It returns to the store soon with a fixed description.
Players no longer spawn outside the map in Wager Match Gun Game.
Fixed empty classes after Classic Prestiging.

title: November 19 update
summary: A big full-auto buff pass: range and damage go up for most ARs, SMGs and LMGs, the Mosin-Nagant trades raw damage for much longer one-shot range, and the new War Chest event comes to DMZ.

changes.text: Headshot multiplier up from 1.3 to 1.35.
Max damage range up 12% (31.24 m), mid damage range up 9% (47.24 m). Min damage up from 22 to 24.
Max damage range up 12% (36.83 m). Min damage up from 32 to 34.
Min damage up from 24 to 25.
Max damage range up 27% (33.53 m). Min damage up from 29 to 30. Headshot multiplier up from 1.3 to 1.4.
Apex attachment: max damage range up 25% (13.72 m), mid damage range up 35% (27.69 m).
Max damage range up 7% (11.18 m), mid damage range up 14% (22.61 m).
Max damage range up 12% (13.97 m). Leg multipliers up from 0.95 to 1.
Max damage up from 18 to 19. Upper torso, lower torso and neck multipliers up from 1 to 1.06.
Max damage range up 4% (12.45 m).
Max damage up from 30 to 31, but max damage range down 7% (20.32 m). Lower torso multiplier up from 1 to 1.1.
Max damage up from 22 to 23, min damage up from 19 to 20. Lower torso multiplier up from 1 to 1.1. Assault Apex: max damage 25, mid damage 24, mid damage range up 35% (58.42 m).
Max damage down from 95 to 91, but max damage range up 188% (43.18 m). Mid damage down from 93 to 86 with range up to 58.42 m, the second mid tier is removed, and min damage goes up from 60 to 68.
Enforcer Apex (Explosive Slug only): mid damage range up 7% (29.59 m), muzzle velocity up from 220 to 245 m/s.

modes: DMZ: new War Chest event. Open containers (5 points) and safes (50 points) for leaderboard rewards like Fulton Exfils, Tempered Armor Vests and UAVs.
More Weapon, Player and Match Bonus XP in all Wager Match modes and Ground War: Combat Outpost.
Enemies killed by multiple players now drop extra Wager Match trophies.
Joint Fire runs for 24 hours every Friday of Season 1.
other: Fixed several stability issues.
The Tracked and Near Complete tab no longer shows camo challenges complete too early.
Natural Concealment challenge notifications now show reliably.
The studio intro no longer replays after opening settings.
Infinity Ward says more Apex attachment and lethality updates are coming.

title: November 16 update
summary: A fix update: Drill Charge damage at range is cut 75%, the Joint Fire event now runs for 24 hours every Friday through Season 1, and DMZ gets several trait and loot fixes.

changes.text: Impact damage at range down 75%. Close-range damage is unchanged.

modes: Joint Fire now runs for 24 hours every Friday through Season 1.
Fixed a bomb disappearing in Search and Destroy when swapping weapons during a plant or defuse.
Fixed floating banks in Grind.
DMZ: UAV Upgrade Pro minimap zoom-out cut from 3x to 1.5x.
DMZ: Plate Pouch and Plate Organization now correctly show ten plates.
DMZ: Wheelson in X01 no longer targets players with Viper Sense.
DMZ: Lieutenant Dog Tag cash now goes to every squad member.
other: The Crossfire targeting tablet now matches the strafe run direction.
Kills from behind now track at wider angles.
Special camo challenges now show in the Pause Menu, and Battle Pass tiers claim faster.
Perks no longer stay locked after Classic Prestige with Random Operator on.
DMZ: weapon stats now show in Gunsmith and weapon select.
Known issue: Infinity Ward is investigating loadouts resetting after Wager Matches, between matches and between logins.

title: November 13 update
summary: A big weapon update: less flinch for ARs, SMGs, LMGs and pistols, damage range buffs across most guns, a Patriot XMR rework and a Mosin-Nagant range cut. Aim assist no longer works through smoke.

changes.text: Flinch received down 25.4% and flinch inflicted down 7.8%, unless noted.
Mid damage range up about 4% (to 40.13 m). Muzzle velocity up from 470 to 500 m/s.
Max damage range up 7% (22.86 m), mid damage range up 6% (45.72 m). Neck and upper torso multipliers up from 1.1 to 1.13. Flinch received down 5.6%.
Max damage range up 26% (35.31 m).
Max damage range up 6%, mid damage range up 16%.
Mid damage range up 17% (58.42 m).
Max damage range up 6%, mid damage tier removed, min damage up from 22 to 24. Muzzle velocity raised to 640 m/s. ADS out time cut to 0.39s.
Max damage range up 5% (32 m).
Max damage range up 8%, mid damage range up 5%.
Flinch received down 15.6% and flinch inflicted down 15.5%.
Mid damage range up 3%, second mid damage tier removed, min damage up 8%.
Max damage range up 7%, mid damage range up 12%, second mid tier removed, min damage up 14%.
Max damage range up 24%, mid damage range up 6%, second mid tier removed, min damage up 8%.
Max damage range up 22%, mid damage range up 34%.
Max damage range up 11%, mid damage range up 8%.
All three mid damage ranges up (13%, 12% and 4%).
Mid damage range 1 up 7%.
Max damage up 2% but max damage range cut 63% (to 14.99 m). Mid damage 1 up 8% with its range cut 19%. New mid damage tier added at 58.42 m.
Flinch received up 9.6%.
Max damage range up 8%, mid damage range up 5%, flinch received down 20.7%. The Mar-9E1 Apex gets 11% more max damage range and the same flinch cut.
Flinch received down 19.3% and flinch inflicted down 13.3%.
Adverse Apex: max damage range up 34%, mid damage range up 10%. Arm and hand multipliers up to 1.0, legs and feet to 0.9.
Flinch received down 17.8% and flinch inflicted down 4.5%.
Mid damage range up 4%, min damage up 2%.
Mid damage 1 up 3%, min damage up 7%, head multiplier up 8% (1.4).
Both mid damage ranges up 8%.
Lawless Apex: mid damage range up 13%.
Launchers now take flinch.
Aim Grips cut flinch received by 2.0% and Heavy Stocks by 1.1%. Ammunition types now add 30.8% flinch inflicted.

modes: Wager trophies drop more often in all Multiplayer modes and in DMZ.
DMZ: a Resupply Run event is live.
DMZ: the team is reviewing time-to-kill and playtesting changes.
DMZ: X01 Legendary Ingredients now sell for cash instead of materials.
other: Aim assist is off when shooting through Smoke Grenade or Smoke Wall smoke.
Create a Class keeps certain Operators after Prestiging.
Special camos for the Cronen Osprey and CSG-35 now show in the Shared Camos tab.
Fixed CDL Operator heads and missing Grind token sounds.
DMZ: Weapon Manuals, Recipes and Dog Tags convert when deploying to X01 from Hajin.

title: November 12 update
summary: A fix update: Fast Hands now speeds up tactical equipment as intended, the Schlager Indigo-RF gets its sniper glint back, and DMZ fixes insurance in X01 and Wager trophy drop rates.

changes.text: Now speeds up certain tactical equipment animations as intended.

modes: Kill Block Private Matches now allow up to 12 players.
Wager trophies no longer drop in Private Matches.
DMZ: Wager trophies drop at the intended rate.
DMZ: Operator and weapon insurance keeps working after death in X01 when deploying from Hajin.
other: Restored the missing sniper glint on the Schlager Indigo-RF optic.
Attachment pips show orange again instead of white.
Several Wager Match fixes, and Wager trophy totals no longer reset between rounds (the UI still shows a reset).
The Battle Pass no longer shows In Progress after all tiers are done.
DMZ: Grizzly vehicles stop once the driver is eliminated.
DMZ: Thermal Padding and an active Sedative Inhaler now hide you from UAV Upgrade.
DMZ: some BlackCell camo challenges now track correctly.

title: November 11 update
summary: Every ballistic gun gets a 3.91x hitscan increase in all modes, with true hitscan range now around 35 m. A new long-range bullet simulation cuts bullet connection time by 34 ms, mostly helping ARs at mid and long range.

changes.text: Hitscan increased 3.91x at all ranges in all modes. Average true hitscan range is now about 35 m.
New long-range bullet simulation cuts bullet connection time by 34 ms, mainly improving mid- and long-range AR consistency.
No longer deals extra damage to Killstreak vehicles.

modes: More end-of-match XP in Infected and Ground War.
The Hardcore Shransit playlist shows the correct name and description.
DMZ: Bounties are earned slightly faster in solos and duos.
DMZ: Bombing Run is disabled in X01.
other: Closing garage doors no longer leaves Tripwires active.
Removed a window on Backstab that blocked grenades.
Prestiging no longer removes some ammo attachments from owned Blueprints.
The Death's Door sound no longer plays after skipping a killcam.
Keyboard and mouse players now see a Killstreak slot in the in-game menu.
DMZ: HUD overlap, Battle Pass reward claim and FOB Operator skin fixes.

title: November 10 update
summary: A fix update: Ghost no longer hides players firing unsuppressed guns, nameplates stop showing through walls, and DMZ disables UAVs in X01 and pays cash on failed exfils.
modes: Match-wide chat is now on in Free for All and Gun Game.
Fixed the Care Package progress bar acting up when collected during Frontline spawn protection.
DMZ: failed exfils now pay cash based on the value of looted items and time deployed (not in Story Missions).
DMZ: UAVs and Advanced UAVs are now disabled in X01.
DMZ: Mini Tracker Trait radius slightly reduced.
other: ADS sensitivity now switches back to hip sensitivity sooner when you stop aiming.
Fixed Ghost sometimes hiding players who fired unsuppressed weapons.
Fixed enemy nameplates showing when the enemy was out of sight.
Fixed Killstreak target markers vanishing after briefly flying out of bounds.
Fixed Folding Iron Sights clipping on some guns, the CSG-35's VLK Trimmer optic rail not adjusting in Gunsmith, and a long Cronen Osprey swap animation that delayed firing.
Fixed Firing Range hitmarkers for slower bullets, and the SAM Airburst Turret and Tactical Insertion showing their location when pinged.
DMZ: fixes for stuck AI, Exfil Helicopter damage, X01 elevators and vaults, and Platinum camo tracking for the Cronen Osprey and CSG-35.

title: November 7 update
summary: A bug-fix update: the Gunship Killstreak, Map Voting for three-map playlists, Battle Pass token progress and a batch of DMZ X01 fixes.
modes: Map Voting now supports three map and mode combos, like Shransit.
Fixed Grind objectives not spawning in Private Match.
DMZ: player kills in X01 no longer raise Bounty Level more than intended.
other: Fixed players being kicked out of the Gunship Killstreak when their Operator was eliminated.
Fixed Field Upgrade equipment being lost on some surfaces on Lithium.
Fixed Battle Pass progress not rolling over when a Token was used.
Fixed players getting stuck on the scoreboard after a Hardcore match.
Operator Selection menu now shows Operator Variants more clearly.
DMZ: fixes for X01 stability, The Captain and Colossus killing players in Last Stand, SAM Sites hitting paid Light Helo Infils, the Orders menu and the BlackCell camo challenge.

title: November 6 update
summary: Shransit playlist and Hardcore in Quickplay, a better Damage Recap, and DMZ stealth gear now hides you from upgraded UAV Towers.
modes: New Shransit playlist: Shipment, Shoot House and Transit 213.
Hardcore is now in Quickplay.
DMZ: Thermal Padding, Thermal Padding Pro and Sedative Inhaler now hide you from UAVs and upgraded UAV Towers. AUAV fire support still finds you.
other: Damage Recap now shows Quick Fix healing, damage through surfaces, Bomb Squad reduction and Spawn Protection.
Fixed Loadouts breaking after Prestiging and a freeze on first loadout edit in a match.
Fixed completed Events not counting toward Event Mastery Camo progress.
Fixed the Kastov 762 Apex alternate fire stopping after a Munitions Box or Ammo Cache in Ground War.
DMZ: fixes for BlackCell rewards and challenges, Order and Calling Card tracking, and Rocket Launcher Blueprints in the Gunsmith.

title: Season 1 update
summary: Season 1 goes live at 9 PM PT. 17 guns retuned (Hyeon Hyperburst Apex and APOC-338 nerfed), Hardcore health cut, Claymores and mines arm faster, and the Cronen Osprey and CSG-35 arrive.

changes.text: Medium damage range up 11% and muzzle velocity up 13%.
Headshot multiplier raised from 1.25 to 1.3.
Medium damage 24 to 25. The Hyperburst Apex takes a big hit: max damage 30 to 23, min damage 25 to 20, and its mid damage band is gone, but max range is up 26%.
Medium damage 24 to 25 with longer range, and higher head, neck and upper torso multipliers.
Max range up 8% and headshot multiplier 1.25 to 1.3. Hurricane Apex max range up 11%.
Max damage range up 7% and ADS move speed up.
Max damage range up 11% and min damage 13 to 14.
Medium 2 damage 13 to 14 and min damage 12 to 13.
Damage ranges shortened about 4 to 5%, min damage 13 to 14.
Max damage 26 to 27, min damage 17 to 19, headshot 1.3 to 1.4. The second mid damage band is removed.
Medium 2 damage 15 to 16 and min damage 13 to 14.
Min damage 33 to 32 and headshot multiplier 1.35 to 1.3.
Max damage range up 3% and headshot 1.25 to 1.3. Assault Apex gets more range and 23 medium damage.
Damage ranges up, min damage 14 to 16. Enforcer Apex ranges up and min damage 19 to 20.
Max damage range up 9%.
Max damage range up 19% and min damage 58 to 63.
Max damage range up 6% and lower torso multiplier 1.0 to 1.1.

modes: New maps: Backstab and Canyon, plus Shoot House returns and Kill Block: Crash joins the featured combos.
Grind returns and Drop Zone joins the rotation. Gauntlet 1v1 is coming soon through a Wager Match event.
New weapons: Cronen Osprey (AR) and CSG-35 (SMG) come with the Battle Pass. Two more guns and new attachments arrive later in the season.
Hardcore max health cut from 30 to 22.
Argonaut killstreak health 800 to 1,200. Crossfire gets spawn protection but less bullet damage and radius.
Claymore arms in 0.75 s (was 1 s) with a wider trigger cone and range. Proximity Mine arms in 0.75 s (was 1.5 s).
DMZ: new X01 underground black site reached from Hajin, a 3D Printer and new vendor at the FOB, and Supplied Drops now works on Dynamic Op crates.
DMZ: Possum lockout radius is 2.5x bigger and its failsafe timer goes from 4 to 5 minutes.
other: Fixes for Birdseye, Battle Hardened, Portable Radar in Free For All, Smoke Wall, Wheelson, Deathstalker and killfeed icons.
Fixed a Proximity Mine exploit on Seeker Drones and an out-of-bounds exploit at Wolves Stadium.
Hijack, Search and Destroy and Gunfight fixes.
DMZ: Weapon XP from vehicle kills against AI lowered, Banks battery spawns reduced, and many fixes for exfil, vehicles and Dynamic Ops.

title: October 30 update
summary: Infected joins the Halloween weekend playlist, plus server fixes and bigger DMZ cash rewards.
modes: Infected added to the playlist for Halloween weekend.
DMZ: Dynamic Ops now pay 10,000 to 20,000 cash, Side Ops pay 2,000 and mission steps pay 500 each.
other: Fixed server crashes.
Fixed a black screen after auto-assign team switches in Private Matches.
Fixed early AFK kicks in Search and Destroy.
Fixed exploits on Coal.
DMZ: fixes for Broken Resupply and Hunt Operator ops, Boss Board Intel purchases, the helmet-hit icon color, FOB shadows and a FOB crash.

title: October 29 update
summary: Possession arrives for Halloween, XP is up in several modes, and DMZ cash rewards go up again.
modes: Possession added as a Halloween playlist mode.
XP rates raised across several Multiplayer modes.
DMZ: cash rewards raised for Dynamic Ops, Side Ops and Story Mission replays.
other: Fixed Lithium visuals and out-of-bounds spots on Silkworm and Mumbai.
Fixed the Domination scoreboard timer and removed extra callouts on Shipment.
Fixed Mastery Camo progress counting squadmate actions.
DMZ: fixes for Scavenger detection on deploy, hostage pickup, Dog Tag extraction, Hajin stuck spots and a helicopter collision on exfil.
Fixed Calling Card requirements and a white flash in menus.
The Level 37 3-Plate Armor Vest fix only applied to players who hadn't reached that level yet. A fix for affected players is in progress.

title: October 28 update
summary: First weapon tuning pass: hit-location damage is more consistent and SMGs get stronger. Shipment 24/7, Kill Block Gunfight and Gun Game arrive.

changes.text: Max range raised, but neck and upper torso multipliers lowered.
Max range raised.
Max range raised.
Neck, upper torso and lower torso multipliers lowered. Sentinel Apex range and muzzle velocity reduced.
Hyperburst Apex: full-auto damage lowered, full-auto range raised, and mid damage range 1 removed.
Light barrel and skeleton grip have a smaller recoil control penalty.
ISO Nightshade, PPSh-41, VEL 46, Wz.55 Striga and X-58 Nyx have higher limb multipliers.
ADS-in and movement speeds adjusted.
Void Apex range raised.
Head multiplier raised and Void Apex range raised.
Damage and range lowered.
Range and upper arm multipliers lowered.
Assault Apex minimum damage raised.
12G Slug mid damage range 2 lowered.
Health regen now stops when you take damage. Hitmarker icon updated.
Closed an out-of-bounds exploit.

modes: Shipment 24/7, Kill Block 6v6 Gunfight and Gun Game added.
Free For All has a score limit of 30 and a party limit of 2.
other: Dive velocity cut by 23% to stop a sprint-jump exploit. A longer-term fix is planned.
DMZ: the Possum trait can't activate while the killing team is nearby or until 4 minutes pass.
Fixes for camo and Calling Card UI, Prestige resets, killfeed icons, Gun Game character select, challenge range tracking, UAV visibility on Sentry and Mosin-Nagant visuals.
Known issues: Patriot XMR Platinum camo tracking, Calling Card tracking, Best Play, and Classic Prestige class creation via DMZ.

title: October 25 update
summary: More XP in Search and Destroy and Collateral, plus Multiplayer and DMZ fixes.
modes: Search and Destroy and Collateral: XP per kill raised from 100 to 300.
other: Rolled back a Search and Destroy bomb stretching fix.
Fixed Collateral bomb behavior and a freeze on first loadout edits.
Fixed Frontline and Hijack announcer intros.
Fixed Patriot XMR, Oden and Cronen Squall weapon class labels.
Fixed a Korean-language launch issue and Gunsmith and Prestige UI bugs.
DMZ: Drill Charge damage to the Colossus reduced, Hospital Elevator bypass closed, and you must clear your Overflow Stash before deploying.

title: October 24 update
summary: Hijack spawn timing improved, plus visual and exploit fixes in Multiplayer and DMZ.

changes.text: Fixed an attachment visual bug.

modes: Hijack spawn and respawn timing improved.
other: Fixed La Sombra Venenosa magazine bullet visuals.
Fixed Portable Radar in Hardcore and a Search and Destroy defuse exploit.
Fixed a Deathstalker out-of-bounds spot on Rooftops and Collateral favorite Operators.
DMZ: fixes for Hajin rocks, party leaders removing teammates, the exfil helicopter disappearing, Shopping Mission reinforcements and Philanthropist Order tracking.

title: October 23 update
summary: Apex Attachments are pulled for now while weapon tuning is reviewed. FFA allows parties of 4.

changes.text: Removed for now. They will return soon.
Tuning for DMZ and Multiplayer is under review.
Weapon level icons added.
Now has 3 uses.
No longer breaks right away in radiation zones.

modes: Parties of up to 4 can queue for Free For All.
DMZ: you can steal back UAV Towers.
other: Events panel updated.
Fixed Portable Radar in FFA and Deathstalker collisions on Summit.
DMZ: fixes for stability, Bounties, Hajin rocks, Lieutenant Hunt progress, AI helicopters, missing audio and killstreak drops.

title: Launch patch
summary: Infinity Ward's pre-launch update. Every gun got a balance pass, SMGs got stronger up close, and one-shot weapons got toned down.

changes.text: More effective at close to mid range.
Tempered with flinch and damage tuning.
Full balance pass, and attachments were retuned.
Prestiging a gun relocks its attachments, shared ones included.
Now negates most of the effects of Flash, Concussion and Screamer Mine.
First recharge comes in faster.
Tactical Sprint now comes from this perk, triggered by your sprint key by default.
Effective range and duration slightly reduced.
Effective range and duration slightly reduced.
Health up from 100 to 150. Still costs 5 kills, or 4 with Hardline.
Pathing and targeting reworked to be more aggressive.

modes: 20 maps at launch: 12 Core 6v6, 4 Gunfight and 3 Ground War, plus Kill Block for 3v3 and 10v10 Gunfight.
New modes: Inflation, Hijack, Collateral, Combat Outpost and Hardcore.
Infected and Possession arrive the week after launch.
Proving Grounds adds a movement and combat training course.
Smart Streaks: objective play now fills your killstreak meter.
Spawn tuning for player separation, squad spawns and Hardpoint.
other: Fixed a server crash during Multiplayer matches.
Fixed visual issues on Cachette.
Fixed Seeker Drone deploying out of bounds.
Fixed the killstreak counter resetting after Argonaut.
Fixed match completions not being recorded.
Fixed the Firing Range showing 0.00 TTK for the Rezi 12.
Gunsmith builds now save manually. Edits made in a match still save on their own.
Shorter pre-game countdowns and earlier map preloading.
